description: This Java source file defines an Android Activity named MenuInflateFromXml which demonstrates inflating menus from XML resources. The activity includes UI components like a spinner to select different menu XML files, and handles menu creation and item selection, showcasing dynamic menu inflation and interaction.

classes.name: MenuInflateFromXml
classes.description: An Android Activity that demonstrates inflating menus from different XML resources, with UI controls to select menus and interact with menu items.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes UI components, sets up the spinner for menu selection, and prepares the activity layout.

methods.name: onCreateOptionsMenu
methods.description: Inflates the selected menu XML resource into the options menu.

methods.name: onOptionsItemSelected
methods.description: Handles menu item selections, providing feedback and toggling visibility of grouped items.
